signIn.title: Sign in to SIRes
signIn.lead: Super Intelligence Researcher is part of the eTroy platform. Your account is managed by eTroy.
signIn.note: SIRes has no password of its own. You go to the eTroy sign-in page and then come back here.
signIn.footer: SIRes · eTroy platform · built by the eTroy SWE, GEN AI, AIE and PO teams
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. What you were typing is kept and comes back after you sign in.
signIn.error.oidc_unavailable.title: eTroy is temporarily not responding
signIn.error.oidc_unavailable.body: No data was changed. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, contact your eTroy administrator.
signIn.error.login_cancelled.title: Sign-in was cancelled at eTroy
signIn.error.login_cancelled.body: No data was changed. Select “Sign in with eTroy” when you are ready.
signIn.error.login_failed.title: Sign-in failed
signIn.error.login_failed.body: No data was changed. eTroy could not confirm this sign-in; try again, and if it keeps failing, contact your eTroy administrator.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.uiLanguageHint: Does not change research content, drafts or fixed terms.
preferences.agentLanguageHint: Drafts are still written in the manuscript’s language.
preferences.debug.label: Debug mode
preferences.debug.explain: When on, the full prompt and response of later Agent Runs are kept for 30 days, then deleted; only the account owner can see them. Turning it off does not delete what was already kept. Turning it on or off is recorded as an Audit Event.
preferences.thresholds.title: Verification thresholds
preferences.thresholds.lead: The Verification Agent uses these thresholds to grade claim support and flag citation mismatches. The defaults are calibrated for support accuracy ≥ 85% and mismatch detection ≥ 95%.
preferences.thresholds.invalid: Enter a number from 0 to 1, for example 0.8.
preferences.thresholds.applies: Applies from the next verification; existing results do not change.
preferences.thresholds.supported.name: Supported
preferences.thresholds.supported.desc: claimSupport.supported: lowest score for a claim to count as Supported.
preferences.thresholds.partiallySupporte: claimSupport.partiallySupported: lowest score for a claim to count as Partially Supported.
preferences.thresholds.mismatch.name: Citation mismatch
preferences.thresholds.mismatch.desc: citationMismatch.mismatch: a citation scoring below this is flagged as a mismatch.
preferences.thresholds.dialog.title: Restore default thresholds?
preferences.thresholds.dialog.body: All three thresholds go back to the system defaults. Verification runs already done do not change.
preferences.savedPreferences: Language and debug mode were saved.
preferences.notSavedThresholds: The verification thresholds were not saved.
